description: Helper functions used for testing interactive rebase operations, including setting fake editors, testing rebase ranges, and managing rebase state.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Sets up a fake editor script to simulate user input during rebase tests.

methods.name: set_cat_todo_editor
methods.description: Sets up a fake editor that outputs the rebase todo list, used for testing.

methods.name: test_linear_range
methods.description: Verifies that a sequence of revisions forms a linear range with specified subjects.

methods.name: reset_rebase
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing rebase and resets the repository state.

methods.name: cherry_pick
methods.description: Cherry-picks a commit and tags it.

methods.name: revert
methods.description: Reverts a commit and tags it.

methods.name: make_empty
methods.description: Creates an empty commit and tags it.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Checks that environment variables related to the editor are unchanged.

methods.name: set_reword_editor
methods.description: Sets up scripts to test rewording commits during rebase.

methods.name: check_reworded_commits
methods.description: Verifies that commits have been reworded correctly after a rebase.

methods.name: set_replace_editor
methods.description: Replaces the rebase todo list with specified content for testing.
